//go:build e2e && (svc_k8s_runner || svc_agents_orchestrator || smoke)

package tests

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"sync"
	"syscall"
	"testing"
	"time"

	runnerv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/runner/v1"
	runnersv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/runners/v1"
	zitiv1 "github.com/agynio/e2e/suites/go-core/.gen/go/agynio/api/ziti_management/v1"
	"github.com/openziti/sdk-golang/ziti"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
)

// This fixture uses the native service identity lifecycle and existing policy.
// It never changes transport enforcement or creates authorization grants.
func dialNativeRunner(t *testing.T, opts ...grpc.DialOption) *grpc.ClientConn {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	registry := runnersv1.NewRunnersServiceClient(dialGRPC(t, envOrDefault("RUNNERS_ADDRESS", "runners:50051")))
	var service string
	token := ""
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for {
		page, err := registry.ListRunners(contextWithIdentity(ctx, clusterAdminIdentityID, identityTypeUser), &runnersv1.ListRunnersRequest{PageSize: 100, PageToken: token})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("discover native runner: %v", err)
		}
		for _, r := range page.GetRunners() {
			if r.GetName() != "k8s-runner" {
				continue
			}
			expected := "runner-" + r.GetMeta().GetId()
			if service != "" || r.GetMeta().GetId() == "" || r.GetOpenzitiServiceName() != expected {
				t.Fatal("bundled runner discovery is ambiguous or has an invalid native service")
			}
			service = expected
		}
		token = page.GetNextPageToken()
		if token == "" {
			break
		}
		if seen[token] {
			t.Fatal("runner pagination repeated a token")
		}
		seen[token] = true
	}
	if service == "" {
		t.Fatal("native bundled runner not registered")
	}
	mgmt := zitiv1.NewZitiManagementServiceClient(dialGRPC(t, zitiManagementAddr(t)))
	enrolled, err := mgmt.RequestServiceIdentity(ctx, &zitiv1.RequestServiceIdentityRequest{ServiceType: zitiv1.ServiceType_SERVICE_TYPE_ORCHESTRATOR})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("enroll native runner test client: %v", err)
	}
	id := enrolled.GetZitiIdentityId()
	if id == "" {
		t.Fatal("native enrollment returned no identity ID")
	}
	var deleteOnce sync.Once
	var deleteErr error
	deleteIdentity := func() error {
		deleteOnce.Do(func() {
			cleanupCtx, stop := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
			defer stop()
			_, deleteErr = mgmt.DeleteIdentity(cleanupCtx, &zitiv1.DeleteIdentityRequest{ZitiIdentityId: id})
			if status.Code(deleteErr) == codes.NotFound {
				deleteErr = nil
			}
		})
		return deleteErr
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := deleteIdentity(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("delete native test identity: %v", err)
		}
	})
	var cfg ziti.Config
	// Never include identity JSON or its decoded key material in diagnostics.
	if json.Unmarshal(enrolled.GetIdentityJson(), &cfg) != nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid native identity configuration")
	}
	overlay, err := ziti.NewContext(&cfg)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("initialize native test overlay")
	}
	t.Cleanup(overlay.Close)
	// Chart 0.73.0 uses native ziti-management 0.13.0: a five-minute lease
	// with a one-minute GC sweep. Never renew a hung fixture indefinitely.
	lifetime, stopLifetime := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Minute)
	renewalCtx, stopSignals := signal.NotifyContext(lifetime, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	stopRenewal := func() { stopSignals(); stopLifetime() }
	done := make(chan struct{})
	failures := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		defer close(done)
		ticker := time.NewTicker(30 * time.Second)
		defer ticker.Stop()
		for {
			select {
			case <-renewalCtx.Done():
				overlay.Close()
				if err := deleteIdentity(); err != nil {
					failures <- fmt.Errorf("delete cancelled native fixture: %w", err)
				}
				return
			case <-ticker.C:
				renewCtx, stop := context.WithTimeout(renewalCtx, 10*time.Second)
				_, err := mgmt.ExtendIdentityLease(renewCtx, &zitiv1.ExtendIdentityLeaseRequest{ZitiIdentityId: id})
				stop()
				if err != nil && renewalCtx.Err() == nil {
					failures <- fmt.Errorf("renew native test identity lease: %w", err)
					overlay.Close() // Fail closed; never fall back to TCP.
					return
				}
			}
		}
	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		stopRenewal()
		<-done
		select {
		case err := <-failures:
			t.Error(err)
		default:
		}
	})
	options := append([]grpc.DialOption{}, opts...)
	options = append(options, grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()), grpc.WithBlock(),
		grpc.WithContextDialer(func(ctx context.Context, _ string) (net.Conn, error) { return overlay.DialContext(ctx, service) }))
	conn, err := grpc.DialContext(ctx, "passthrough:///"+service, options...)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("dial native runner overlay: %v", err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { conn.Close() })
	return conn
}

// The transport repair must never make raw TCP control usable.
func TestRunnerControlRejectsTCP(t *testing.T) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	conn, err := grpc.DialContext(ctx, runnerAddr, grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()), grpc.WithBlock())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("connect runner readiness transport: %v", err)
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	_, err = runnerv1.NewRunnerServiceClient(conn).StartWorkload(ctx, &runnerv1.StartWorkloadRequest{})
	if status.Code(err) != codes.Unauthenticated || status.Convert(err).Message() != "runner_control_requires_ziti" {
		t.Fatalf("raw TCP runner control must reject before request validation: %v", err)
	}
}
